waivers.reason: Webhook API on Azure Functions without browser content or a static-host header file (the check reads netlify.toml, _headers, vercel.json, staticwebapp.config.json). The Functions host sets the API security headers in code when it is added; the rule needs a variant for API hosts upstream.
Same as HOS-001: no static-host header file. Azure Functions enforces HTTPS (httpsOnly); HSTS is set in code with the host.
Same as HOS-001: no static-host header file. nosniff and frame-ancestors 'none' are set in code with the host.
A webhook API serves no static or hashed assets, so there is nothing to cache immutably.
